prize_parts.citation: for foundational conformal-field-theory methods revealing universal behavior at two-dimensional critical points

statement.case_for: B003 remains my preferred achievement. It identified a compact and extraordinarily generative description of criticality: symmetry and locality constrain the long-distance physics so strongly that exact, universal results become possible. This is not merely a useful formalism; it changed how statistical physicists connect microscopic disorder to universal observable behavior, with a mature legacy across critical phenomena and quantum field theory. The proposed trio represents complementary foundational contributions to the physical formulation, exact structure, and broad application of the framework.
statement.case_against: The intellectual lineage of conformal field theory is wide, and a three-person award inevitably compresses contributions by many theorists. Its experimental consequences are also less easily represented by a single canonical measurement than those of the leading instrumental candidates.

responses.point: Eriksson argues that B059 transformed correlated-electron theory into a quantitatively useful framework, with Georges, Vollhardt, and Kotliar forming a defensible foundational trio.
responses.response: I agree that DMFT is an unusually mature and influential theoretical achievement and it is my strongest alternative. Yet its prize boundary is less sharp: the original conceptual method, later computational extensions, and materials-specific implementations are deeply intertwined. CFT more cleanly isolates a foundational universal mechanism and has a longer, more unified conceptual identity.

responses.point: Lindroth emphasizes that B013 established geometric and topological quantum phases with broad, experimentally consequential effects over many decades.
responses.response: I agree that the Aharonov–Bohm and Berry effects are fully mature and fundamental. My qualification is the same one Lindroth identifies: they are distinct historical and physical discoveries, so a joint citation risks joining achievements rather than recognizing one coherent advance. That attribution issue places B013 below B003 for me.

responses.point: Olsson stresses that B006 overcame the practical resolution limit of electron microscopy and has transformed materials physics through reproducible sub-angstrom imaging.
responses.response: This is an exceptionally strong experimental alternative, especially because theory, instrumental realization, and scientific impact are all evident. I remain cautious because the credit chain extends through parallel correction approaches and many instrument-building teams; the historical boundary for three names requires more scrutiny than B003.

uncertainties: Whether the historical record supports this precise three-person compression of the broad development of conformal field theory.
Whether the committee should favor a directly instrumental breakthrough over a foundational theoretical framework in this cycle.
statement.conflict_note: No specific connection requiring recusal is apparent from the supplied profile. I share the Gothenburg physics environment with Göran Johansson and Eva Olsson, but no specific collaboration or connection to a shortlisted achievement is supplied.
